why_it_moved.text: Successful Search Rate - Tail Queries rose 3.1% and survived the false-discovery correction, while the overall rate barely moved.
why_it_moved.label: measured

why_it_moved.text: The new ranker may help rare queries only, which are too small a share of traffic to lift the overall rate.
why_it_moved.label: inferred

would_change: A pre-exposure comparison of Successful Search Rate showing the arms were not matched before exposure began would make this result unreliable.
A daily series by days since first exposure would let the novelty check run; it could not run here.
